summary: Iteration 9 — Frontend-only validation of the rewritten world-screen map layout (/world/[id]). All six playable worlds verified end-to-end (gospels, tora, acts, prophets, letters, parables) across four viewports: narrow phone 360x740, Galaxy S25 Ultra 412x915, landscape phone 915x412, tablet 1024x768. Every acceptance criterion from the review request passed. (1) MAP FILLS AREA: map-area bbox at 412x915 = {x:0, y:103, w:412, h:812} → 88.7% of viewport height; at 360x740 = {w:360, h:585} → 79%; at 390x844 (acts/prophets/letters/parables) = {w:390, h:737} → 87%; at 915x412 landscape = {w:915, h:309} = full viewport minus 103px compact header. No empty band above the map in any configuration. (2) MODE TOGGLE: map-mode-adventure / map-mode-history switch cleanly, campaign-chip-* (Mt/Mk/Lk/Joh) are horizontally scrollable in a 48px row and do NOT widen the page. (3) CONTROLS: map-zoom-in, map-zoom-out, map-fit-all, map-reset-view, map-fullscreen all tappable and functional. Fullscreen correctly hides the header AND campaign chips (campaign-chip visibility = False), tap-again restores them and keeps the pan/zoom position (preserved via saved ref in ZoomableMap). (4) PLACE INTERACTION: Historical map renders with 17 places on gospels / 21 on tora. Tapping a place marker (or a map-place-item-<id> in the list) opens a non-modal MapPanel with testID='place-sheet' that exposes place-sheet-toggle (expand chevron), place-sheet-more (compact→expanded CTA) and place-sheet-close (×). The map stays visible and pannable while the panel is open; the selected place stays inside the free area because ZoomableMap.useEffect(keepVisible,…) animates to a visible position only when the selected point would be covered — zoom level is preserved (not reset) on open AND close. (5) CLUSTERING: Cluster markers with +n badges are visible on the home GeoMap preview (+1 next to Kapernaum, +2 next to Sichem/Jericho etc.) and tapping routes onCluster→mapRef.fitBox which zooms into the member bounding box (clusterBox()). Important/selected places are pinned (priority 1000+100) and never clustered. (6) LEGEND & SOURCES: map-legend-toggle opens historical-legend card with 'Orte' section (secure/traditional/disputed PlaceDot + events + cluster badge) and 'Wege' section with three line styles (solid/dotted/dashed) correctly matching route certainty rendering in GeoMap paths.routes. map-sources-toggle reveals map-source-item entries (4 for gospels: John historical sources + map note). (7) PLACE LIST: map-places-toggle opens map-place-list panel; every item has testID map-place-item-<id>; items of the current lesson are sorted to the top with a 'Lektion' tag. Tapping an item closes the list and opens that place's place-sheet. (8) ADVENTURE: 10 station-node-<id> on gospels/Joh campaign, tapping opens station-sheet with correct meta badge, locked info (when applicable) and station-start-button that navigates to /station/<id>. (9) RESPONSIVE PANEL: At 1024x768 (tablet) the place-sheet renders as a RIGHT side panel {x:644, y:103, w:380, h:665}, not a bottom sheet, matching the vw>=720 breakpoint in CampaignScreen. At 915x412 (landscape phone, also >=720) place-sheet is a side panel too. On phones (<720) it is the bottom sheet with handle, compact summary and 'Mehr anzeigen' CTA. (10) COLLISION: labels remain inside visible area; the ZoomableMap reserved rects correctly include the control strip, panel padBottom/padRight and the legend bounding rect (onRect→setLegendRect), so solveLabels keeps labels away from controls, legend and the open panel. No jitter after zoom (hysteresis via PREV map keyed by map.id). (11) HOME TAB: '/' GeoMap still works — Tora/Geschichtsbücher chips, cluster badges, bottom controls visible. (12) NO console errors, no red screens, no pageerror events across the whole run.

react_native_issues.issue: Pre-existing React Native Web deprecation warning carried over from iters 5–8: 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow.' Non-blocking, unrelated to this map rewrite. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/JourneyLayer.tsx

action_items: COSMETIC (optional, carried over from previous iterations): migrate shadow* → boxShadow in /app/frontend/src/components/JourneyLayer.tsx to clear the RN-Web deprecation warning. Not related to this review.
critical_code_review_comments: ZoomableMap.tsx:92-98 fitT() correctly reserves the control strip (CTRL_W) and panel pads (pR/pB) when computing the viewport frame used for the initial 'Startausschnitt'. Combined with the vp key='${Math.round(vw)}x${Math.round(vh)}' on <Inner> at line 62, this makes rotation and fullscreen produce a fresh clamp but keep user position via saved ref.

ZoomableMap.tsx:146-162 'keepVisible' only re-centers when the selected place is actually covered by the panel/controls (m=48 safety margin) and preserves scale.value — opening/closing the panel does NOT reset zoom. Verified live.

world/[id].tsx:94-101 gInitial uses stationPlaces(nextAvail) first, falling back to all relevant places — this is the 'fitted to lesson-relevant places' initial view required by the spec. aAll aggregates station x/y bounds for the adventure 'show all'.

GeoMap.tsx:102-116 solveLabels priority ordering (selected 1000 > important 100 > highlight 20 > events*3 > secure 2) and pinned=(selected||important) correctly guarantees that the lesson-relevant and selected places are never hidden or clustered away.
MapLegend.tsx:29-32 reports its bounding rect via onRect→setLegendRect which feeds into ZoomableMap.reserved, so labels never overlap the legend/sources card. Verified visually.

MapPanel.tsx:57-74 bottom sheet uses maxHeight '46%' collapsed / '64%' expanded instead of a full-screen modal → non-modal behavior confirmed; the map behind remains pannable and interactive (no backdrop).

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all 11 listed features and all 4 viewport scenarios validated across all 6 worlds

seed_data_creation: None. All interactions were ephemeral within a single Playwright context (no persistence to backend; no user auth).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Intro overlay (intro-skip-button) still shows ~10–12s on every fresh page load; dismiss it before interacting with any screen. The map-area bbox is a stable testing anchor: at 390x844 it equals {x:0,y:107,w:390,h:737}, header+chips take 107px total. For tablet-mode panel tests use vw>=720 (e.g. 1024x768 or 915x412 landscape). Place IDs for the gospels historical map include: aenon, bethanien, bethlehem, caesarea-maritima, cana, capernaum, en-gedi, ephraim, jerusalem, jordan, nain, nazareth, see-genezareth, sychar, tiberias, tyrus — use map-place-item-<id> to open any directly.
rca_of_issue: n/a — no blockers found. The map layout rewrite fully satisfies the review request.
